title: Ray diagram sheet
subject: Science
source: Seeded from science/y6 lesson 1 (Ray diagram sheet (portal worksheet))
intro: Lesson 1: Light travels in straight lines. To understand that light travels from a source in straight lines

picture.alt: Sunbeams in straight lines through clouds
picture.draw: Draw and label: Ray diagram sheet

questions.q: Draw a ray from a torch to a wall.
questions.a: A straight ruler line with an arrow pointing from torch to wall
questions.model: Start at the source: the torch. Use a ruler: light goes straight. Add an arrow pointing away from the torch towards the wall.

questions.q: Name two light sources and one object that is not a source.
questions.a: For example: Sun, candle; a mirror is not a source

questions.q: Why do you see a sunbeam through a window as a straight band?
Do the card holes test with a torch. Draw the set-up with rays when the holes line up and when they do not.
questions.a: Two diagrams: straight ray through all holes; ray stopped at the moved card
questions.model: Teacher draws the lined-up diagram on camera with a ruler and arrows.

questions.q: Explain how a shadow shows light travels in straight lines.
questions.a: Light cannot bend round the object, so a dark area of the same shape forms behind it.

questions.q: How long does sunlight take to reach Earth (about 150 million km at about 300 000 km per second)?
Big question: why can't you see round a corner?
questions.a: Light travels in straight lines, so it cannot bend round to reach your eyes.
